title: 第一卷 第25章 不断吃惊的姐妹花！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
只一瞬！

    出云宗十几位化龙境长老皆身死道消！

    只留下血雾与遍地狼藉。

    伊年怜看到这一幕，吓得面色惨白，呆愣原地。

    即便是足以飞升上界的‘神明’，也做不到这种程度的事情！

    下一刻，这位称霸此方小世界，身上背负了数万条人命的邪修老魔，没有丝毫犹豫的跪在了雪姨面前，磕头如捣蒜。

    “上仙饶命！”

    “小人只是下界小修，实在不知有什么地方得罪了上仙，还请上仙大人有大量，把小人当个屁给放了吧……”

    伊年怜如今的卑微，与之前狰狞嗜杀的残暴，简直判若两人！

    雪姨没有说话，回头看向了姜无痕。

    她在询问姜无痕的意思。

    伊年怜见状，顿时皱眉，眼底浮现出震惊与错愕。

    这位仿若仙人般强大的女子，居然对一个跟自己修为差不多的小辈如此恭敬？

    “倘若面对的只是那个小辈，尸魂幡内，百万邪魂尽出，未尝不能将其拿下，甚至……将他化作本座的傀儡！”

    求生的本能，以及对权力的渴望，让他心里产生了一个大胆的想法。

    几乎是在瞬间，伊年怜眼底闪过一抹狠色。

    邪功运转，周身魔气赫然爆发，整个人如一支离弦之箭，手握尸魂幡，杀向姜无痕。

    “敢坏本座的好事，让你也沦为本座的傀儡！”

    伊年怜发了疯似的怒吼着，尸魂幡中，释放出了百万邪魂！

    同时，殿外无数尸傀嘶吼着，将三生殿围得水泄不通。

    “恩公，当心！”

    安祈雪姐妹俩见状，吓得花容失色，连忙提醒。

    下一刻，却见姜无痕祭出极道人皇幡，挥舞之下，百万邪魂瞬间湮灭。

    同时，极道人皇幡斩碎了伊年怜手中的尸魂幡，连同他的身躯，竖着斩成了两段。

    当伊年怜回过神来的时候，灵魂已经被摄入了极道人皇幡内。

    “这，怎么可能！”伊年怜灵魂颤栗，惊骇万分，“本座怎么会输给一个……乳臭未干的小辈？”

    “我乃出云邪尊，谁人敢斩我，谁人敢炼我……”

    话音未落，极道人皇幡之上燃起地狱业火，伊年怜的灵魂在业火之中，发出全然不似人声的惊悚惨叫。

    连同雪姨方才斩杀的十几位出云宗长老的灵魂，一同被卷入地狱业火，成为了滋养人皇幡的养料！

    这一幕，更是让安祈雪姐妹俩大为吃惊！

    伊年怜！

    那可是成名已久的盖世老魔，创生莲华界百万修士的噩梦！

    居然就这么轻松的被一击斩杀了？
content_en:
Just for a moment!

More than a dozen elders of the Dragon Transformation Realm of Izumo Sect all died!

Only blood mist and mess were left.

When Yi Nianlian saw this scene, he turned pale with fright and froze in place.

Even 'gods' who are powerful enough to ascend to the upper world cannot do such a thing!

The next moment, this old evil cultivator who dominated this small world and was burdened with tens of thousands of human lives knelt down in front of Aunt Xue without any hesitation, kowtowing like garlic.

"Exalted Immortal, have mercy on me!"

"The villain is just a minor cultivator from the lower realm. I really don't know how I have offended the Supreme Immortal. I have asked the Supreme Immortal to treat him like a fart..."

Yi Nian Lian's current humble state is completely different from his previous ferocious and bloodthirsty cruelty!

Aunt Xue said nothing and looked back at Jiang Wuhen.

She was asking what Jiang Wuhen meant.

When Yi Nianlian saw this, he frowned immediately, shock and astonishment appeared in his eyes.

This woman, who is as powerful as an immortal, is so respectful to a junior who is similar to her in cultivation?

"If we are only facing that junior, and all the millions of evil souls emerge from the Corpse Soul Banner, we might not be able to capture him, or even... turn him into my puppet!"

The instinct of survival and the desire for power gave him a bold idea.

Almost instantly, a ruthless look flashed in Yi Nianlian's eyes.

The evil power was running, and the demonic energy around him suddenly exploded. He was like an arrow leaving the string, holding the corpse flag in his hand, and killed Jiang Wuhen.

"If you dare to ruin my good deeds, you will become my puppet!"

Yi Nianlian roared like crazy, and millions of evil souls were released from the corpse soul flag!

At the same time, countless corpse puppets roared outside the hall, surrounding the Sansheng Hall.

"My benefactor, be careful!"

When the sisters An Qixue saw this, their faces turned pale with fright, and they quickly reminded them.

The next moment, Jiang Wuhen was seen offering the Jidao Human Emperor flag. With the wave, millions of evil souls were instantly annihilated.

At the same time, the Jidao Human Emperor Banner chopped into pieces the Corpse Soul Banner in Yi Nianlian's hand, and cut his body into two pieces vertically.

When Yi Nianlian came back to his senses, his soul had been absorbed into the Jidao Human Emperor Banner.

"How is this possible!" Yi Nianlian's soul trembled and she was horrified, "How could I lose to a...younger person?"

"I am Izumo Evil Lord, whoever dares to kill me, whoever dares to refine me..."

Before he finished speaking, the hell karma fire was ignited on the Jidao Human Emperor flag. In the karma fire, Yi Nianlian's soul let out a horrifying scream that did not sound like a human voice at all.

Together with the souls of the dozen Izumo Sect elders that Aunt Xue had just killed, they were drawn into the karma fire of hell and became the nourishment for the Human Emperor Banner!

This scene shocked the sisters An Qixue even more!

Yi Nian Lian!

That was the long-famous old demon who created the nightmare of millions of monks in the Lotus World!

Was he killed with one blow so easily?
